corrections.reason: Stage 1 hallucinated a non-Ethiopic Hebrew character (צ) for the Fidel 'ሰ' in 'ተሰልበ' ('where their Lord was crucified') and misread 1st-order 'ኀበ' as 'ኅበ'.

corrections.old_text: ሳሌም ፡ ም ፡ ፲፯ ፥ ፲፱ ። ሉቃ ፡ ፲፫ ፥ ፴፬ ።
corrections.corrected_text: ሳሌም ፡ ም ፡ ፲፮ ፥ ፲፱ ። ሉቃ ፡ ፲፫ ፥ ፴፬ ።
corrections.reason: The printed numeral is ፲፮ (16, referring to Revelation 16:19 where the great city is mentioned), with the characteristic top-left loop of ፮ misread as ፯.
